'''Nuyu's''' was a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] shop owned by [[Nuyu]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lafrarian]]. The owner of the shop made a fairly good living selling cosmetic body alterations to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that frequented the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]], which Nuyu's was located on. In existence by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the shop was located in the market on StarForge Station.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuyu's first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. The shop is provided as an example of the stores in the market that players can shop at when the ''Far Orbit'' goes to StarForge Station.<ref name="Orbit" />
